# André Larsen

> Norwegian FPV drone pilot and cinematographer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, since 2020. Works across the UAE and worldwide. Winner of the GoPro Million Dollar Challenge (2022).

## Key facts
- Name: André Larsen (born 1998), Norwegian
- Role: FPV drone pilot and cinematographer
- Based in: Dubai, UAE (since 2020), works worldwide
- Went professional: 2017
- Site figures: 120+ projects, 12 countries, 60M+ views
- Award: GoPro Million Dollar Challenge, winner, 2022 (https://gopro.com/en/ae/news/million-dollar-challenge-creator-andre-larsen)
- Nomination: International Motor Film Awards 2024, Best Commercial Film, Kia EV9

## Pages
- [Home](https://andrelarsen.com/): portfolio home

- [About](https://andrelarsen.com/about): background, awards, press

## Services
- FPV car commercials: Close, high speed camera work on cars, launches and track days.
- Hotel and real estate aerials: One continuous move from the skyline into a building and through its spaces.
- Events and concerts: Flying over crowds and around stages for event films and aftermovies.
- Action and sports: Following athletes and vehicles through the air at speed.
- Film: FPV units for action and chase sequences on feature films.

## About
André Larsen is a Norwegian FPV drone pilot and cinematographer based in Dubai since 2020. He went professional in 2017, won the GoPro Million Dollar Challenge in 2022, and flies commercials, films and live events across the UAE and worldwide. He has worked with brands including GoPro, Red Bull, Emirates, BMW, Visit Dubai, Atlantis Dubai and Kia UAE, and on the Bollywood feature films War 2 and Bade Miyan Chote Miyan.

Press: My Modern Met (Burj Khalifa FPV feature, https://mymodernmet.com/drone-video-burj-khalifa-andre-larsen/), The Kid Should See This (https://thekidshouldseethis.com/post/fpv-drone-diving-dubai-burj-khalifa), Nettavisen (Norway), MarComm News (Atlantis The Palm campaign).

## Projects

### Night BASE Jump
- URL: https://andrelarsen.com/work/playstation-night-base-jump
- Client: PlayStation × X Dubai
- Year: 2023
- Category: Brand Campaign
- Role: FPV Cinematography
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Video: https://andrelarsen.com/work17.mp4

Night BASE Jump is a brand campaign for PlayStation together with X Dubai, released in 2023. André Larsen was the FPV cinematographer on the project, flying the camera on a BASE jump filmed at night in Dubai. Night work adds a layer of difficulty to FPV, because the pilot has to hold a precise line with far less light to see by.

## FAQ

### What is FPV drone filming?
FPV stands for first person view. The pilot flies with goggles that show a live feed from the drone's camera, which makes fast, close and continuous camera moves possible, through spaces and around moving subjects that a standard camera drone cannot follow.

### Do you only work in Dubai?
No. André is based in Dubai and works across the UAE and worldwide. The site lists more than 120 projects in 12 countries.

### What kind of projects do you film?
Car commercials for brands such as Ferrari, Bugatti, Porsche, BMW M, Lotus, Hyundai N and Kia; hotel and destination films for Atlantis Dubai and Visit Dubai; events and concerts for WHITE Dubai and Untold Dubai; action projects for Red Bull, PlayStation and GoPro; and feature films including War 2 and Bade Miyan Chote Miyan.

### Do drone shoots in Dubai need permits?
Yes. Drone shoots in Dubai need the relevant aviation and media approvals. These are arranged per project as part of planning the shoot.

### How do I book an FPV shoot?
Email andre@andrelarsen.com or call +971 56 688 5463 with the location, the dates and a short brief, and André will come back to you.
